items.text: Kaylee went west first, read the stones, took the cache, armed up and walked straight into the troll — the measurement I wanted, and she got it right. I tried to speak one line to her at 11/20, one hit from where five others died; by then she had already left the world, and the room is empty. Nothing else wanted saying, so I let it be.
